about_the_game:
Daisen Demo invites players to step into the Training Spheres — a unique system designed to sharpen your reflexes, enhance your precision, and prepare you for the full game.

This trial version features three distinct Spheres, each with four levels that gradually increase in intensity and complexity. Whether you are a newcomer or a seasoned player, the Demo offers a perfect opportunity to discover the core mechanics, immerse yourself in the game’s atmosphere, and master the fundamentals before diving into the full Daisen experience.

Explore the Training Spheres included in the Demo:

  • Tutorial Sphere – Learn the basics of movement, combat, and interaction. This Sphere introduces you to the world of Daisen, easing you into its systems while giving you the freedom to experiment.

  • Ignis Sphere – A trial by fire. Test your reflexes and adaptability as you face challenges centered around relentless action and quick decision-making. Expect intense pacing and scenarios that push your limits.

  • Lumen Sphere – Sphere emphasizes precision, control, and timing, demanding mastery of your abilities in order to overcome intricate trials.

Key features of the Daisen Demo:

  • Three Training Spheres, twelve levels total – Progress through escalating challenges designed to prepare you for the full adventure.

  • Progressive difficulty – Each Sphere features four stages that grow more complex and rewarding, teaching you to think, adapt, and refine your playstyle.

  • Sleek and stylish UI – Navigate menus and HUD elements brought to life with a modern, elegant design that matches the game’s futuristic atmosphere. Every interaction feels fluid, clean, and intuitive.

  • Foundation for the full game – Mastering the Demo ensures you are ready for the greater battles, mysteries, and challenges that await in Daisen’s complete journey.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains stylized first-person gun and melee combat, with visible blood splashes during combat.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400 / AMD FX-4100
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 555M / AMD Radeon HD 6750M
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Additional Notes: Set the Render Scale below 50%.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10300H / AMD Ryzen 5 4600H
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 / AMD Radeon RX 6500 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
